blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United States President Donald Trump arrived in Malacañang on Wednesday as part of his short state visit to the Philippines. Trump was received by President Ferdinand Marcos and other high-ranking government officials at Kalayaan Grounds, where he was given full military honors before they proceeded to Malacañan Palace for a bilateral meeting and state luncheon. Trump arrived in Manila on Tuesday evening for several engagements with the heads of state of the Association of the Southeast Asian Nations (Asean).
